<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political friction:</strong> The BJP has launched a protest march in Chandni Chowk against the Congress, while Prime Minister Modi criticized the opposition party following recent MLC election results.</li>
  <li><strong>Legislative shifts:</strong> Bina MLA Sapre has returned to the Assembly after switching from Congress to the BJP, marking a notable shift in regional political alignment.</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>
